title: jobsOutput
responsibility: Format observed duration distributions and queue scheduling scenarios with Lisbon finish clocks and explicit fallback notes.

inputs.name: jobDuration.ms
inputs.description: Nonnegative elapsed milliseconds to format; null displays unknown. Whole seconds round upward.

inputs.name: printJobEta.result
inputs.description: Queue scheduling result containing counts, slots, percentile-duration scenarios, sample fallbacks and uncertainty warnings.

inputs.name: printJobStats.groups
inputs.description: Observed per-type/model duration summaries, including sample count, running mean, median and nearest-rank p80/p90.

outputs.name: jobDuration
outputs.description: Hours, minutes and rounded-up seconds, or unknown for a null duration.

outputs.name: printJobEta
outputs.description: No return value; registers deferred Commander actions or prints the supplied report without changing queue inputs.

outputs.name: printJobStats
outputs.description: No return value; registers deferred Commander actions or prints the supplied report without changing queue inputs.
